summary: Tested /minhas-inscricoes.html header changes (seduc-theme.js?v=22, served on all 6 pages). Mobile (390x844 dsf=3 is_mobile/has_touch and Pixel 7 393x851): #mnav-open missing from the shadow root, 0 .mnav-layer, 0 a[href], logo image visible, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals viewport width), tapping the logo keeps the URL. Desktop 1920x800: header shows the logo plus Institucional/Concursos/Avaliações/Certificações/Acesso à universidade/Educação. 29 <a> elements with 0 href, logo cursor is default. Clicking all 6 visible items with locator clicks and by text, and clicking the logo with a mouse coordinate click, never changed the URL or opened a new page. vn-wait was not stuck and body opacity was 1. Page content works: the empty state shows 'Nenhuma inscrição encontrada neste dispositivo.'. With localStorage data the card renders Nº/Nome/CPF/Cargo/Valor and 'Clique para ver os detalhes →', and clicking it goes to /inscricao-realizada.html. '← Voltar' goes to /inscricao-realizada.html. Regression: inscricao, dados-inscricao and confirmacao have the full mobile drawer (× + 6 items + Fazer inscrição + Página de acompanhamento) and 38 header a[href]. Desktop Institucional really navigates to '/'. pagamento-pix and inscricao-realizada have the reduced drawer (× + Página de acompanhamento only). All checks passed.

issues: Footer links (Sobre nós, Novos, etc.) still navigate. This is out of scope because the request was header-only. Mentioned only in case the user expects the whole page to be non-navigable.

critical_code_review_comments: The minhas-inscricoes check uses a /minhas-inscricoes/ regex on pathname in two places (lines 52 and 54). Fine, but it could be merged into one variable.
seed_data_creation: localStorage inscricao_dados with a TEST USER, set only in the test browser context
context_for_next_testing_agent: The header lives in the open shadow root of #seduc-header-host. On minhas-inscricoes, build() removes #mnav-open/.mnav-layer, strips hrefs and blocks clicks with a capture-phase listener. Other pages are unchanged (38 or 31 header hrefs). Use .jpg for screenshots that use quality.
